name: voice-foundations
description: Thirteen provider-neutral skills for building, debugging and reviewing AI voice agents: stack selection, turn taking, conversation design, speech pipeline, audio frontends, latency, media debugging, call reliability, data capture, evaluation, cost, phone compliance and security.

interface.longDescription: Thirteen skills that help you build, debug and review AI voice agents people enjoy talking to. They cover choosing a stack, turn taking and interruptions, prompts for spoken conversation, speech-to-text and text-to-speech, audio quality, latency, silent or one-way audio, dropped calls and failed transfers, capturing phone numbers and other details correctly, testing, cost per minute, phone compliance and security. The skills are provider-neutral and work with managed platforms and open-source frameworks alike. They are for developers building voice or phone agents. They give engineering guidance, not legal advice, and they do not place calls or connect to any service.
defaultPrompt: Why does my voice agent keep interrupting callers?
Help me choose a stack for a phone voice agent.
Estimate what my voice agent will cost per month.
